name: Condom Commander
storyline:
Condom Commander — Storyline

Deep inside the human body, an invisible war has begun.

For generations, the microscopic defense forces protected the bloodstream from harmful bacteria, viruses, and infections. But everything changed when a mysterious super-pathogen known as The Corruptor appeared.

The Corruptor is unlike any infection the body has faced before. It can mutate ordinary germs into aggressive creatures, build toxic colonies, and open portals that spread contamination from one organ to another. As the infection grows, entire regions of the body begin to collapse.

The immune system launches its strongest antibodies, but they are quickly overwhelmed.

With no other options left, the scientists of the microscopic defense program activate their most unusual prototype:

Condom Commander.

Armed with powerful protective technology, rapid-fire weapons, shockwaves, and an energy shield, Condom Commander enters the infected body. His mission is to travel through contaminated cells, destroyed blood vessels, toxic laboratories, bacterial colonies, and mutation zones before the infection reaches the heart and brain.

During his journey, Condom Commander collects coins and uses them to purchase upgrades, stronger weapons, improved protection, and new combat abilities. Every defeated enemy reveals more information about the outbreak and unlocks entries in the Commander’s collection album.

However, the deeper he travels, the more dangerous the infection becomes.

Every tenth level, Condom Commander must face a powerful boss created by The Corruptor. These mutated guardians protect the pathogen’s laboratories, portals, and infection cores. Each victory brings the Commander closer to the source of the outbreak—but also reveals that the invasion may not be a natural infection.

The Corruptor is building an army.

Its final goal is to take complete control of the body, transform it into a living infection factory, and spread to the outside world.

To stop it, Condom Commander must fight through more than one hundred increasingly dangerous levels, destroy the mutation network, close the infection portals, and confront The Corruptor in its central hive.

The fate of the body rests on one unlikely hero.

Protect. Fight. Survive.

Become the Condom Commander.
summary: Condom Commander is a fast-paced arcade shooter where you battle waves of viruses, bacteria, and mutated infections inside the human body. Collect coins, unlock upgrades, use powerful special weapons, and defeat dangerous bosses to stop the ultimate outbreak.
